name: Podcast Hosting Review
trigger_keywords: how did i do as host
description: Reviews Improving Edge hosting with coaching feedback

name: Obsidian Source Note
description: Write a structured Source Note to Obsidian from any content type (podcast, article, video, book). Applies the Source Note template with Tags block, verbatim transcript, and Key Concept Summary. Use when saving a podcast, article, or source for future reference — especially for talk building.

name: LinkedIn Post from Blog
description: Draft a LinkedIn post from a Ghost blog URL using a contrast-hook structure. Fetches post via MCP, identifies core tension, drafts under 120 words with hook/expansion/distillation/challenge arc, and runs a 7-check quality gate before returning copy-paste ready output.

name: Episode Transcript Intake
trigger_keywords: turn this episode into a campaign
description: Retrieves and normalizes a podcast episode (public URL or internal Improving Edge episode) into a clean transcript plus episode metadata. First step of the Podcast-to-Pipeline pipeline.

name: Pain Point Extraction
description: Extracts structured, quote-grounded pain points from a podcast transcript. Second step of the Podcast-to-Pipeline pipeline.

name: Audience Profile Builder
description: Builds a target audience profile (ICP) from an episode's extracted pain points. Third step of the Podcast-to-Pipeline pipeline.

name: Offering Match
trigger_keywords: what do we sell for this
description: Matches episode pain points to Improving's real, current service offerings by searching live SharePoint sources - never a cached or invented list. Fourth step of the Podcast-to-Pipeline pipeline.

name: Account Targeting
trigger_keywords: who should we target for this
description: Finds real target accounts for an episode's audience profile - CRM first, LinkedIn to fill gaps. Includes a mandatory compliance pre-check. CRM-write-adjacent research skill (Plan-Only Mode).

name: Contact Targeting
trigger_keywords: who do we reach out to
description: Drills from target accounts to individual contacts matching the audience profile's buyer role - CRM/Clay-first, LinkedIn as tie-breaker and title authority. Plan-Only Mode supported.

name: Prospect Message Draft
description: Drafts personalized cold-outreach message content for one campaign contact, reusing harper-email's voice/tone pattern but producing content only - feeds campaign-send's Journey Email asset.

name: Campaign Setup
description: Creates the Segment and Journey for an episode in Customer Insights - Journeys, adds target contacts. Pure CRM write, Plan-Only Mode required, dedups against existing journeys.

name: Campaign Send
description: Fires the actual send for one contact via Customer Insights - Journeys. The one real irreversible side effect in the pipeline - requires explicit per-contact live confirmation regardless of Plan-Only setting.

name: Campaign Response Log
description: Links an inbound reply back to the correct Journey/Contact as a Note or Activity with a Response Type - the manual gap-fill Dynamics doesn't do natively. Runs on-demand, Plan-Only Mode supported.
